# zyxel_acl_rule (Resource)

Manages one IPv4 TCP WAN-to-LAN firewall ACL entry using the router's `firewall_acl` table. Existing rows must be imported by exact name. All configurable fields require replacement because no safe in-place update or reorder operation has been verified. The router applies order globally; this resource does not guarantee a complete firewall policy across independent resources or Terraform states.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zyxel_acl_rule" "https" {
  name                   = "Allow-HTTPS-Example"
  action                 = "accept"
  order                  = 10
  source_cidr            = "198.51.100.0/24"
  destination_cidr       = "192.0.2.10/32"
  destination_port_start = 443
  destination_port_end   = 443
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) ACL action: `accept` or `drop`. The router stores these as `Accept` or `Drop`.
- `destination_cidr` (String) Canonical IPv4 destination CIDR. Changing it replaces the ACL rule.
- `destination_port_end` (Number) TCP port from 1 through 65535; the range end must be at least the start. Changing it replaces the ACL rule.
- `destination_port_start` (Number) TCP port from 1 through 65535; the range end must be at least the start. Changing it replaces the ACL rule.
- `name` (String) Exact, non-empty router rule name. This is the natural identity and import key; duplicate names are ambiguous.
- `order` (Number) Explicit desired order in the router's global ACL table. Existing use of this order is rejected. Router order behavior must be verified before production use.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the ACL rule is enabled. Defaults to `true`; changing it replaces the rule.
- `source_cidr` (String) IPv4 source CIDR. Defaults to `0.0.0.0/0` (any source). Use the canonical network address for the prefix; changing it replaces the rule.
- `source_port_end` (Number) Optional TCP source port range end. Set this together with `source_port_start`; changing it replaces the ACL rule.
- `source_port_start` (Number) Optional TCP source port range start. Leave both source port bounds null for any source port; null maps to router values `-1/-1`.

### Read-Only

- `router_index` (Number) Current router list index, exposed for diagnostics only. Indexes shift after deletes and are never used as resource identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zyxel_acl_rule.https 'Allow-HTTPS-Example'
```
